note: missing = no outline and not a pin-only or line park (the true gap). Pin-only (single sites, historic places, city / county parks) and line parks (trails, rivers) are not missing: they have the right kind of record for what they are. Counts of with_outline include PAD-US and approximate matches. Every column is a count of what the bots have on file; nothing here is a verdict. Kentucky is counted from the KPC-Links answer key. See the docstring of .github/scripts/kpc_scoreboard_bot.py for how each column is decided.
